Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Both a scientist and a truck driver had their bags searched at the airport. A drug-sniffing dog had signalled that officers should look into the bag of the scientist and, sure enough, they found quite a bit of marijuana. After the truck driver's bag was flagged and searched, though, they were let go as it was apparently just a false alarm. Who was free of drugs?
A. The truck driver
B. The scientist
C. Cannot be determined
